name: jit-opt-noopt
description: Whole-fork JIT work: `-XX:+CITime` (compile time, bytecodes and nmethod sizes per tier) and `-XX:+PrintCodeCache` print at JVM exit, in each cell's `jmh.log`. The question: does the `-opt` build give C2 more code to compile and keep?

variantDescriptions.opt: The default build: `scala3-compiler-bootstrapped` with `-opt -opt-inline:dotty.**`, the library with `-opt -opt-inline:**,!java.**`.
variantDescriptions.noopt: `Global / Build.optimize := false` (`noopt.sbt`; same setting as `SCALA3_BUILD_OPTIMIZE=false`): no optimizer flags for the compiler or the library.
